operator_confirmation.queue_action: append both arms to the tail when their executable entries pass readiness gates
operator_confirmation.filler_action: mark each arm preemptible only after its own pause/resume gates pass
operator_confirmation.priority_rule: Priority 2 work must not launch while any Priority 1 work is unfinished.

operator_intent: Compare K=3 caption sampling where a caption is redrawn on every audio visit against one randomly selected caption fixed per audio; allow lower-priority training to run as a preemptible GPU filler only when resume is scientifically valid.

arms.selection: one of three captions on every dataset visit
arms.required_implementation: stateless deterministic draw keyed by immutable seed, epoch, and audio id

arms.selection: one of three captions selected once per audio and then fixed

data.id_alignment: official TSV order and exact ID-set equality
data.architecture: immutable audio latent store plus switchable caption text overlays
data.caption_switch_operation: change the TSV and text_npz_dir manifest binding; never rewrite the audio NPZ store
data.true_random_cache_requirement: separate cache with exactly three aligned text embeddings per canonical audio and shared audio latents
data.fake_random_cache_requirement: separate cache with the fixed selected text embedding per canonical audio and shared audio latents

training.rationale: NoQ isolates caption sampling from quality-bucket conditioning; quarter scale matches the recent fair013 comparisons.
training.q_conditioning_basis: NoQ remains the preregistered single-variable control from the accepted design.

future_full_scale_promotion.default: reuse this arm's accepted Stage 1 100k checkpoint and continue to 400k
future_full_scale_promotion.gate: exact same arm, data/overlay, model, optimizer, batch, seed, conditioning, warmup, and schedule through 100k; otherwise start fresh
future_full_scale_promotion.legacy_rng_rule: If the 100k checkpoint lacks RNG state, register an explicit 100k RNG restart boundary and do not claim uninterrupted-from-zero.

preemptible_filler_contract.filler_role: use otherwise-idle GPU time without lowering scientific priority
preemptible_filler_contract.pause_request_behavior: finish the current optimizer step, atomically save and verify a checkpoint, release the GPU, persist PAUSED, and notify
preemptible_filler_contract.resume_requirement: restore model, optimizer, scheduler, EMA, model RNG, sampler epoch, and exact within-epoch offset
forbidden: SIGKILL as a normal pause mechanism
mutating a shared caption NPZ cache
allowing filler work to delay a newly inserted high-priority entry after the next safe checkpoint boundary
preemptible_filler_contract.handoff: On operator priority insertion, request pause immediately and launch the inserted entry after verified resource release; preserve this experiment's queue position and checkpoint.

current_holds: The current checkpoint omits RNG and within-epoch sampler progress.
The current true-random loader uses worker-local random.randint.
The historical multi-caption extractor writes separate per-caption NPZ files rather than one aligned stacked-caption NPZ per audio.
An isolated K=3 cache has not yet passed ID/content binding validation.
The live top-level queue controller remains held on runtime binding drift and must not be bypassed.
